feed.title: Album of the day on soundcloud

entry.summary: Nearing halfway through the year, so it's time to highlight some favourite discoveries. This is the 2020 album I have listened the most to, methinks. Ole Paus with Motorpsycho as a backing band. Amazing.
entry.title: 2026-06-26: Ole Paus -- Så nær, så nær (2020)

entry.summary: Ole Paus is by some considered a kind of Norwegian Bob Dylan, and, fittingly the 79 years old(!) Dylan also relased an amazing album this year!
entry.title: 2026-06-27: Bob Dylan -- Rough and Rowdy Ways (2020)

entry.summary: Any new album form Pavement's Malkmus is worth a listen. And this one is his latest -- an exploration of folk!
entry.title: 2026-06-29: Stephen Malkmus -- Traditional Techniques (2020)

entry.summary: ...and we're back in the nineties again. Tindersticks this time.
entry.title: 2026-06-30: Tindersticks -- Tindersticks (1995)

entry.summary: Another rusty voice today. The late great Johnny Cash's 4th album of modern cover songs is my favorite. Best track: Hurt
entry.title: 2026-07-02: Johnny Cash -- American IV: The Man Comes Around (2002)

entry.summary: The original version of the best song from yesterday's AOTD, Hurt, can be found on this album. Best track here, though: March of The Pigs
